{{Quote|Terentateks? Those things that eat Force blood? Sure. In fact, I know a half breed Massassi who could take you to one.|Quarren cantina patron|<ref name="Shadows and Light">{{Tales|23|Shadows and Light}}</ref>}}
A '''Quarren''' and his [[Unidentified Ithorian cantina patron|Ithorian]] friend were approached in the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in [[Dreshdae]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] almost four thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[3993 BBY]] by [[Duron Qel-Droma]] and [[Shaela Nuur]], who were on Korriban on a [[Great Hunt (Jedi)|mission]] for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], looking for a [[Terentatek/Legends|terentatek]]. The [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] and [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] agreed to provide the Jedi with information that could help them on their quest&mdash;for the price of one [[Kilogram/Legends|kilo]] of [[Spice/Legends|spice]].
